T: Never go full jungle. Go full snacks.
D: A group of pampered actors shooting a war film end up in a real jungle fight.
P: Serve the snacks when Portnoy starts begging for jelly beans.
S: he wants jelly beans very, very badly

Soft fruit pastilles of mango and raspberry purée set with pectin, cut into cubes and rolled in sugar, piled in a bowl with jelly beans. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Bring 250g mango purée and 250g raspberry purée to the boil with 25g pectin mixed into 50g sugar. Add 450g sugar and 2 tbsp glucose and boil, stirring, to 107C. Stir in 1 tsp citric acid and pour into the tin. Set at room temperature for 4 hours, cut into 2cm cubes and roll in caster sugar. Serve with 200g jelly beans.
Peanut caramel bars coated in milk chocolate
Roasted peanuts bound with a chewy caramel of brown sugar, golden syrup and butter, pressed into a tray, coated in milk chocolate, cut into bars.
Four Leaf's jungle banh mi bites
Baguette bites with pork pâté, char siu, pickled carrot, cucumber and cilantro

Small baguettes with pork pâté, char siu, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Quick-pickle a carrot and some daikon in vinegar and sugar. Split 2 small baguettes, spread with 100g pork pâté and fill with 200g char siu, pickles, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Cut into bites.
M: Spiced beef broth with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon over rice noodles and paper-thin raw beef, with bean sprouts, Thai basil, lime and chilli. Char a halved onion and a 6cm piece of ginger under the grill. Simmer 1.5kg beef bones in 3L water for 3 hours with the onion, ginger, 4 star anise, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves, skimming. Strain and season with 3 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar. Soak 400g rice noodles and divide into bowls with 300g paper-thin raw eye fillet. Pour over the boiling broth. Serve with sprouts, Thai basil, lime and chilli.
Chicken thigh green curry with Thai eggplant in coconut milk

Green curry paste fried in coconut cream until it splits, chicken thigh, coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, Thai eggplant and basil. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in the thick top of 800ml coconut milk until it splits. Add 800g sliced chicken thighs, the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and Thai eggplant. Simmer 15 minutes and add Thai basil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.
W: Sweet coconut sticky rice with sliced mango, coconut cream and sesame seeds
Glutinous rice soaked overnight, steamed 25 minutes, soaked in warm coconut milk with sugar and salt, with ripe mango and a salty coconut sauce.
K: Passionfruit, lime and fresh ginger syrup served over ice

Fresh passionfruit and lime shaken with homemade ginger syrup, topped with soda over ice and a mint sprig. All the buzz, none of the sweat. Simmer 100g sugar, 100ml water and a sliced 5cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Mix with the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Fill four tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top each with 150ml soda water. Stir and add a mint sprig.
